description: This PHP source file contains unit tests for the EmployeeTimeAtWorkDao class within the OrangeHRM project. It tests methods related to retrieving attendance records for employees, including fetching the latest attendance record and records within a date range.

classes.name: EmployeeTimeAtWorkDaoTest
classes.description: A test class that verifies the functionality of EmployeeTimeAtWorkDao methods related to employee attendance records.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment by creating an instance of EmployeeTimeAtWorkDao and populating test data from a YAML fixture.

methods.name: testGetLatestAttendanceRecordByEmpNumber
methods.description: Tests retrieval of the most recent attendance record for a given employee, asserting the correctness of record details or handling absence of records.

methods.name: testGetAttendanceRecordsByEmployeeAndDate
methods.description: Tests fetching attendance records within a specified date range for an employee, validating the correctness of the data returned.
